messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — p99 latency 680ms (5m) for service=inference-api (eu-west). Threshold=600ms. Group=SLO-LATENCY-P99. Page delivered.
maria: ack — oncall (maria). jumping in. any known deploys?
jamal: no deploys in last 30m. I'm seeing a spike in KV cache evictions + many short requests with long seqs (small prompt, many tokens).
devon: checking autoscaler and GPU pool. autoscaler lagging because burst exceeded ramp limits; also some instances hit mem pressure causing throttling. batch sizes trending up concurrently.
maria: quick telemetry — frontend p95 ~ 320ms, backend p99 ~ 650-700ms, kvcache evict rate x12 baseline. looks like hotkeying.
kelsey: customer-impact quick scan: ~1.3% of EU requests breaching SLO; error rates fine. product team FYI: @product-duty
product-duty: saw the ping. preparing customer note if this extends. what’s mitigation?
devon: suggestion: apply a temporary traffic-fuse (route a fraction to dedicated pool), reduce `batch_max_tokens` to 512, and force local KV shard eviction smoothing. should relieve tail.
jamal: applying traffic-fuse now — command: ```
robin route update inference-api --region eu-west --split dedicated=0.25 --policy fuse=true
```
maria: also running warmup on dedicated nodes: ```
curl -s -X POST https://internal-eu/warmup?service=inference-api&count=20
```
jamal: traffic split applied — dedicated-eu-west receives 25% (started at 1749996721).
devon: watching metrics — p99 dropped to ~420ms within 90s. cpu/gpu mem pressure trending down. batch queue depth reduced.
maria: acknowledged in PD. setting status: acknowledged / investigating. leaving short playbook note in runbook: `runbook#latency-fuse`
product-duty: good improvement — holding off customer note for now, will draft if we don't fully recover in 15m.
jamal: also flipped `batching.max_tokens=512` on eu-west routing layer.
devon: follow-up: need longer-term fix — consider hotkey mitigation (KV sharding, per-customer throttles) and increase autoscaler surge window. logging a ticket for infra.
maria: putting this into a short incident: INC-1749996660, severity=sev2, owners=maria/devon/jamal.
incident-bot: update recorded: traffic-fuse engaged, mitigations applied, p99 improved to 420ms. Will monitor for 30m.
maria: leaving final note: keep watch, handoff to next oncall in 25m. if p99 creeps back >600ms reopen and escalate PD. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident INC-1749996660 created and linked to PagerDuty. Closing page for now (ack).
